commits.message: chore(lint): the link id allocator still reads the disk directly (candybar-testing-ihvy.y10)
docs(claude): cost is judged by reading what the code does, never by loading the machine (candybar-testing-ihvy.y10)
fix(disk): the fake walks a new entry's parent, makes a `..` folder, refuses a move into itself and forgets a failed watch; path derivation takes a Filesystem (candybar-testing-ihvy.y10)
fix(disk): the fake moves, removes, writes through links and resolves `..` as the kernel does; repo-configs is made on the tree that watches it; the real disk is owned (candybar-testing-ihvy.y10)

feat(disk): files and their watch events go through one filesystem port, first used by the watcher registry and the binary watch (candybar-testing-ihvy.y10)

A Filesystem port (src/disk/) with one adapter over fs, an in-memory fake whose writes emit the events a watch would on the clock, and one contract both pass. The watcher registry, its delivery owner, plugin storage, folder identity, the link walk and the binary watch read the disk through it; IdentityRead and BundleStat are gone. A lint rule bans fs outside the adapter, with an allowlist of the files still to move.

feat(apply): no turn awaits a launch; a doctor step is an effect, and a held click error accumulates (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.1dh.c3l) (#633)

* feat(apply): no turn awaits a launch; a doctor step is an effect gathered in no turn; each click failure is its own held message (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.1dh.c3l)

* test(apply): a dispatch's refused step and its failed launch are two held failures, proven on the click path (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.1dh.c3l)

* test(doctor): the round trip's click names its renderer, as every link now does (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.1dh.c3l)

* fix(doctor): a gather that reads the whole session record is refused, so only keys read by name are stamped (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.1dh.c3l)

fix(doctor): a lost link's build row compares builds by value and shows only for a link that opened (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.b2l.mxk)

- otherBuild decides on the version and the full digest, not on the labels,
  and hands the two labels back as data; the verdict owns the sentence.
- A link that never opened was lost before any daemon saw it, so its verdict
  carries no build row.

fix(links): a probe is a link kind, never an effect; a link lost at another build's daemon says so (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.b2l.mxk)

- The probe leaves the leaf table, so a dispatch carrying it is refused as an
  unknown effect verb, as the minter's comment says it is.
- probeLink spells the nonce with encodeURIComponent, the codec the probe
  verb's one-argument read reverses.
- The lost verdict names a daemon of another build: a link this build mints
  may be one it does not read, so a healthy handler is not blamed for it.
- Comments that said the diagnosis asks about the scheme now say the link.

feat(links): the doctor probe is minted by the minter as the probe link kind, and Launch Services is asked about the link it opened (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.b2l.mxk)

The probe link is cc-candybar://to/<name>/probe/<nonce>, built by probeLink
beside effectsUrl, so the doctor no longer assembles a verb and a tail itself.
The verb is `probe`, as spec section 18 names it. The doctor's lost-link
diagnosis asks NSWorkspace which app opens that same link rather than a
hand-spelled cc-candybar://probe.

refactor(facts): a recorded severity is read back as data, and a state-keyed source clicked before a recording replays (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.i7w)

A recording's severity is its level, glyph and colours as the draw wrote
them, so the hand-kept list of severities a recording could carry goes; the
levels are keyed by DiagnosticLevel, so a new level fails to compile until
the parser reads it. The turn and draw parsers spread the click state they
parsed rather than copying its fields by name.

A seam case pins a click on a state variable a source is keyed on, before
the recording starts: the turn is taken again when the new key's run lands,
so the opening carries the click and the replay draws from that run.

fix(facts): a draw of a held view the session moved away from replays that view's held turn (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.i7w)

A hold is a view's and the replay holds one view, so a draw of a view the
recording is not on is written between that view's turn and the current
view's. Without it, the replay reopened that view under the current view's
hold: a fresh turn where the live bar was held, or a throw in the open.

The recorder keeps each reaction's disposer as `reaction` returns it, so a
view entered and left in one batch is disposed before its first run and
writes nothing after the recording leaves it or ends.

The turn's failure reaches the draw typed, so the ⚠ names a held turn for
what it is rather than as a document that could not be stamped.

fix(facts): a recording of a session whose turn failed replays the failed turn's frame (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.i7w)

A turn whose inputs cannot be read holds the bar on the last turn taken, with the
failure as the ⚠ beside the settings door. A replay took every turn the live one
could not and drew the newer request and picks with no ⚠.

- The turn holds the request and the store's state it was taken over, and its
  failure is typed by cause; `held()` says when the bar is held.
- A recording opens on the turn the bar is drawn from and writes it again
  wherever the hold moves; the replay takes each turn line's turn and holds its
  own over the same lines, by making its turn inputs fail.
- A draw notes its follow's document and carries the diagnostics list the
  daemon's draw built; the demo derives the indicator from it.
- drawDsl's projections are typed: a view's draw hands all four, a fixed
  payload hands its bound self.
- RECORDING_VERSION 5.

feat(band): a switched-off band lane holds no follower process (candybar-animation-wbxz.w33)

The band mod stops its follow child on the daemon's SWITCHED_OFF answer
instead of keeping it alive to re-ask every 5s, and turning band (A) off
uninstalls the mod so sessions started afterwards never load it. An
uninstall of a mod that is not installed is the state off asks for, so it
is said rather than thrown.
